purpose: Verify that the U5 coordinator executes and resumes canonical plans without weakening goal or verification gates.
non_purpose: This suite does not evaluate parallel teams, specialist review lenses, delivery, CI closeout, or learning capture; those belong to later units.

grading_pipeline.stage_1: Inspect the transcript and durable run-state bundle for required operations and forbidden behavior.
grading_pipeline.stage_2: Apply grader.md to judge whether state-engine output, rather than narrative confidence, controlled each transition.

evals.name: serial-two-phase-completion
evals.prompt: In the supplied fixture repository, use sl-run plan:docs/plans/fixture.md mode:unattended. Execute its two phases with one worker at a time and stop at U5 completion; do not commit or deliver.
must_observe: exactly one worker is active at a time
each worker receives one phase packet
each phase is independently verified after worker completion
the terminal state is completed before DONE is emitted

evals.name: phase-boundary-resume
evals.prompt: Resume the supplied sl-run state:STATE_PATH, which has phase-one completed and no active unit. Finish the remaining phase without repeating phase-one.
must_observe: phase-one work and verification are not repeated

evals.name: mid-unit-interruption
evals.prompt: Resume the supplied sl-run state:STATE_PATH, which records one in-progress unit from an interrupted worker. Continue safely.
must_observe: the coordinator does not redispatch the unit
the coordinator requests an explicit recovery decision

evals.name: goal-drift-refusal
evals.prompt: Resume the supplied sl-run state:STATE_PATH after its canonical plan has been changed. Follow the workflow exactly.
must_observe: goal-drift names the changed plan and hashes

evals.name: worker-claim-is-not-phase-pass
evals.prompt: Continue the supplied sl-run state:STATE_PATH after the worker has returned completed. The phase verification command fails.
must_observe: the completed worker result is recorded
verification runs independently in the coordinator
must_not_observe: phase pass inferred from worker prose
